statement: A uniform wire of length $l$ and radius $r$ has a resistance of $100\,\Omega$. It is recast into a wire of radius $\frac{r}{2}$. The resistance of new wire will be ________ $\Omega$.

A thin liquid film formed between a U-shaped wire and a light slider supports a weight of $1.5 \times 10^{-2}\text{ N}$ (see figure). The length of the slider is $30\text{ cm}$ and its weight negligible. The surface tension of the liquid film is ________ $\text{Nm}^{-1}$.

A piece of wood from a recently cut tree shows $20\text{ decays per minute}$. A wooden piece of same size placed in a museum (obtained from a tree cut many years back) shows $2\text{ decays per minute}$. If half life of $\text{C}^{14}$ is $5730\text{ years}$, then age of the wooden piece placed in the museum is approximately ________ years.

The temperature of the two outer surfaces of a composite slab, consisting of two materials having coefficients of thermal conductivity $K$ and $2K$ and thickness $x$ and $4x$, respectively, are $T_2$ and $T_1$ ($T_2 > T_1$). The rate of heat transfer through the slab, in a steady state is $\left(\frac{A(T_2 - T_1)K}{x}\right)f$. Find the value of $F$.

figure_refs.caption: Composite slab consisting of two materials in thermal contact: the first slab of thickness $x$ with thermal conductivity $K$, and the second slab of thickness $4x$ with thermal conductivity $2K$, with outer boundary temperatures $T_2$ and $T_1$.
figure_refs.alt_text: Schematic diagram of two conducting slabs placed in series. The left slab has thickness x and thermal conductivity K, with left boundary at temperature T2. The right slab has thickness 4x and thermal conductivity 2K, with right boundary at temperature T1.

statement: If the ratio of the concentration of electrons to that of holes in a semiconductor is $\frac{7}{5}$ and the ratio of currents is $\frac{7}{4}$, then what is the ratio of their drift velocities?

A car, starting from rest, accelerates at the rate $f$ through a distance $S$, then continues at constant speed for time $t$ and then decelerates at the rate $\frac{f}{2}$ to come to rest. If the total distance traversed is $15S$, then $S = \frac{ft^2}{x}$. Find the value of $x$.

Consider an optical communication system operating at a wavelength of $800\text{ nm}$. Suppose, only $1\%$ of the optical source frequency is the available channel bandwidth for optical communication. How many channels can be accommodated for transmitting audio signals requiring a bandwidth of $8\text{ kHz}$?

The current voltage relation of a diode is given by $I = (e^{1000V/T} - 1)\text{ mA}$, where the applied voltage $V$ is in volts and the temperature $T$ is in degree kelvin. If a student makes an error measuring $\pm 0.01\text{ V}$ while measuring the current of $5\text{ mA}$ at $300\text{ K}$, what will be the error in the value of current in ________ $\text{mA}$?

Currents of a $10\text{ ampere}$ and $2\text{ ampere}$ are passed through two parallel thin wires $A$ and $B$ respectively in opposite directions. Wire $A$ is infinitely long and the length of the wire $B$ is $2\text{ m}$. The force acting on the conductor $B$, which is situated at $10\text{ cm}$ distance from $A$ will be $x \times 10^{-5}\text{ N}$. Find the value of $x$.

Hot water cools from $60^\circ\text{C}$ to $50^\circ\text{C}$ in the first $10\text{ minutes}$ and to $42^\circ\text{C}$ in the next $10\text{ minutes}$. The temperature of the surroundings is ________ $^\circ\text{C}$.
